capabilities: Obfuscate inline text with a blur effect that reveals on hover
Redact text by replacing characters with brick blocks
Wireframe text with a bone style that reveals on hover
Obfuscate multi-line text inside code fences while preserving punctuation and line breaks
Customize colors and effects with CSS snippets
disambiguation: Not image blurring; it obfuscates text within notes using CSS-based blur, redaction, and wireframe effects.
extras: Brick text never reveals on hover because the original characters are replaced with block characters; the README notes pre-1.0.12 color values were kept as defaults for backwards compatibility.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide or obfuscate text within notes, for example when sharing spoilers, secrets, or wireframed screenshots.

relations.evidence: Custom CSS styles can be applied via the obsidian-style-settings plugin.

summary: Lightweight plugin that obfuscates note text with three effects: blur, brick (redaction blocks), and bone (wireframe), inline or in code blocks.
